draft.details:
On 2026-09-02, I fell on my outstretched right hand at the Emergency Department, Auckland City Hospital. I was X-rayed and told my wrist was a sprain, with no follow-up. The pain did not go away. On 2026-10-12, a repeat scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed exams and shifts at my part-time job. I am seeking an explanation, an apology, and to know what support or compensation is available.

Starship Child Health, part of Health New Zealand Te Whatu Ora Te Toka Tumai (Auckland) says: "N.B Scaphoid fractures are extremely rare in children under 10 years of age." Could Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora Auckland | Te Toka Tumai please explain how this recommendation was considered in my care?
draft.outcome: An explanation, an apology, and to know what support or compensation is available
